page_title: LEC 0-4 ATA | Lecce v Atalanta 19/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The match has just finished.
90+2' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Ibrahim Sulemana (Atalanta) replaces Mario Pasalic.
90+1' Medon Berisha (Lecce) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
90' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marco Brescianini trots off the pitch and is replaced by Marco Palestra (Atalanta).
89' Federico Cassa (Atalanta) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
83' Here is a change. Hamza Rafia is going off and Luca Gotti gives the last tactical orders to Medon Berisha (Lecce).
83' Substitution. Federico Cassa (Atalanta) has come on for Mateo Retegui.
80' Ederson (Atalanta) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Davide Massa had an easy-decision to make.
80' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) launches himself at a lofted pass, but his close-range header flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
79' Lecce take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

79' Lameck Banda (Lecce) beats a few defenders in the penalty area and drives a low shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts superbly to make a wonderful save. Now Lecce have a corner.
76' Substitution. Filip Marchwinski (Lecce) in, Ylber Ramadani out.
75' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Juan Musso.
74' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Juan Musso.
73' Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ben Godfrey (Atalanta) comes onto the pitch for Davide Zappacosta.
69' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nikola Krstovic.
69' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Charles De Ketelaere will be replaced by Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta).
68' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) is caught offside!
66' 0 - 4 Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom right corner, leaving the keeper helpless.
65' The resulting set piece from Lecce is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
60' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
60' Neat passing move from Lecce in order to create new attacking opportunities.
57' 0 - 3 Goal! Wladimiro Falcone gets a hand on the penalty from Mateo Retegui (Atalanta), but can't stop it from flying low into the middle of the goal.
57' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
55' The Atalanta players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
55' Referee Davide Massa makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
55' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
54' It will be a corner kick for Atalanta. Ederson (Atalanta) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Wladimiro Falcone easily deals with the threat.
52' Atalanta control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

51' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) has a big opportunity to score! He climbs highest deep inside the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the goal. Next time he should aim better as his effort flies narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
50' Davide Massa blows for a foul after Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
49' Lameck Banda (Lecce) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
48' The Lecce players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Luca Gotti gives a chance to Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) and Balthazar Pierret is off.
46' Half-time substitution. Tete Morente will not participate anymore and Lameck Banda (Lecce) is coming on.
46' Davide Massa blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' 0 - 2 Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) jumps for a cross and plants a perfect header inside the right post.
43' Ederson (Atalanta) was too forceful with his tackle and Davide Massa interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
40' Atalanta enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
35' 0 - 1 Goal! Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.

35' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the roof of the net. Wladimiro Falcone displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

34' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) bursts into the penalty area with the ball at his feet after a wonderful individual effort that left fans breathless and in awe. However, he sends the ball in a completely different direction than intended, well wide of the target. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
33' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
32' The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
31' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Davide Massa has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
27' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.

25' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.

24' What a save from Wladimiro Falcone! Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the left post, but the goalkeeper has pulled off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
24' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
23' None of the Atalanta players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

23' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. The ball is out of play. Atalanta win a corner kick.
21' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
18' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) makes a strong challenge and Davide Massa blows for a foul.
17' The Atalanta players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
16' Wasted effort! Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
12' Lecce failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
11' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
11' Lecce can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

11' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Patrick Dorgu (Lecce), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lecce will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
9' Davide Massa interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ederson (Atalanta).
9' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
8' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Corner kick. Atalanta will have an opportunity.
7' Davide Massa blows his whistle. Hamza Rafia (Lecce) commits a foul after dangerous play.
6' Rough tackle by Marten de Roon (Atalanta). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Atalanta seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Tete Morente (Lecce) makes a rough challenge and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) takes the corner but it's cleared.
1' The first half has just begun.
Lecce will kick-off.
Federico Dionisi is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
